item.title: PETS OF WEEK: Hades and Gizmo
item.description: Hades is a 4-year-old medium mixed breed weighing about 62 pounds. He came to the shelter after his previous family could no longer keep him due to housing changes, and he’s ready for a fresh start in a loving home.…

item.title: DNR set to OK drainage of 52-acre Seeley Lake, return recreation area to its natural state
item.description: Project opponents have argued the lake provides a habitat for birds and other wildlife and is a popular recreation destination. The owners want to re-establish the natural floodplain.

item.title: Baraboo, Portage shelters step up services in bitter cold
item.description: Pathway Home in Baraboo and River Haven in Portage have had to increase normal service levels to help people escape brutal conditions.

item.title: Blues band to perform at River Arts
item.description: River Arts will host the Madtown Mannish Boys at 7 p.m. Friday in Leola Hall at the Sauk Prairie River Arts Center, 105 Ninth St., Prairie du Sac.

item.title: Portage police posthumously honor their first female officer with a new award
item.description: Penny Kiefer died on July 17, nine years after retiring from a 38-year career in various department capacities.

item.title: Colvin awarded $2K nursing scholarship
item.description: In partnership with Madison College, leadership from Reedsburg Area Medical Center presented a $2,000 scholarship to Angela Colvin of Lyndon Station on Jan. 12.

item.title: Baraboo Kiwanis Club seeks Dippel Award nominations
item.description: The Baraboo Kiwanis Club is now accepting nominations for the Dr. Al Dippel Community Service Award. The award is named after Dippel, a Charter member of Baraboo Kiwanis who gave his time to many community causes.
